guide.title: Integrate Your Live TikTok Account
guide.desc: To display your live TikTok posts dynamically without slowing down your site, we use Curator.io - a safe and free responsive social media feed builder.
guide.step1Desc: Go to curator.io and register for a free account.
guide.step2Desc: Select TikTok source, authenticate or search for @amamazanonaha.ltd, and create a feed.
guide.step3Title: Add your Widget ID to Environment Variables
guide.step3Desc: Copy the unique hash identifier of your published feed (looks like a long string of letters and numbers).
guide.tip: Tip: after adding the ID to your .env file, restart the development server to see the live feed.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.description: What people ask us most about the platform, and what it does for customers and businesses.

problem.q: What problem does Amamazanonaha Ltd solve?
problem.a: We solve the absence of a single trusted platform bringing together business information, products and services. We help customers find what they need easily and quickly, and we help companies become better known and reach new business opportunities.

technology.q: How does Amamazanonaha Ltd use technology to solve it?
technology.a: We have built a modern digital platform that connects people, companies and markets. Customers can search, compare and choose trusted products and services without leaving where they are.

customers.a: Customers get reliable information in one place and more options to choose from, and they can compare and decide with confidence — saving both time and money.

customerOpportunities.q: What opportunities do customers get by using Amamazanonaha Ltd?
customerOpportunities.a: Customers gain real opportunities to order the products and equipment they want from China and from anywhere in the world — simply, reliably and quickly, saving them both time and money.

businesses.q: What do businesses gain by using the Amamazanonaha Ltd platform?

points.p1: Present their products and services professionally.
points.p2: Reach more customers in Rwanda and beyond.
points.p3: Build a strong name and trust in the market.
points.p4: Open up more sales and partnership opportunities.

businessSupport.q: How does Amamazanonaha Ltd help businesses and brands?
businessSupport.a: We help businesses and brands build a verified, professional Business Profile that clearly presents the products and services they offer, where they operate, their key information and what they stand for.

verifiedProfile.q: Why does a Verified Business Profile matter?
verifiedProfile.a: A verified profile gives customers confidence, showing them the business is recognised and trustworthy. That builds trust, raises visibility in the market and opens up more chances to win new customers.
